observations: The historical bot plugin materializes composable behavior packages and chains guard, aiming, recovery, offense and reaction systems after condition update. Source fixtures and tests describe intended composition and control-only scenarios; actual scheduler interactions, authority and current behavior remain open.

Historical defense selects nearest or explicitly targeted opponents, checks incapacitation and optional facing, samples a dodge choice and delay, then submits a shared defend intent when the timer finishes. Native event ordering, duplicate reactions and probability/config admission require connected tracing.

Historical offense selects a live non-yielded opposing target, obtains equipment/ammunition and lunge facts, maintains explicit pursuit, windup, guard, cooldown and withdrawal phases, and switches to melee when ranged prerequisites fail. Several errors stop movement or retain a phase; full state transitions and failure atomicity need independent review.

The historical melee and ranged phases consume raw AI precision and ranged deadband fields; a separately attributed 95e source trace already records conditional admission consequences and their relation to checkpoint 059. This historical body read does not promote its bytes or conclusions to checkpoint 3821.
